task_reconstruction.official_task: 2023 MCM Problem C, Wordle: the report count, the hard-mode share, the try distribution, and word difficulty.
required_outputs: a forecast interval for the report count on March 1, 2023
a decision on whether word attributes change the hard-mode share
a try distribution for EERIE with an interval
a letter to the puzzle editor

writing_logic.summary: The curve is described before the model is chosen.
The base model is reviewed and remapped before it is changed.
A correlation is refused twice, first for size and then for cause.
The method is justified by a constraint it satisfies.

contributions.summary: Regularity and purity are defined from a first-order chain.
The report count is given an interval from 1000 bootstrap refits.
The hard-mode correlation is attributed to a shared time trend.

models.summary: MU-C-Q257-001: a first-order chain giving a geometric mean and a negative entropy
MU-C-Q257-002: four compartments with participation, boredom, conversion, and loyal boredom
MU-C-Q257-003: separate lines from one feature to the hard-mode share, then lines on time
MU-C-Q257-004: an average of the nearest words' score shares
MU-C-Q257-005: a three-class neighbor vote on the median number of tries

dependency_graph.label: The two regularities are the only features that correlate with the hard-mode share.
Weighted regularity and weighted purity enter the neighbor average.
The loyal compartment is the curve the hard-mode share is later compared with.
The try shares are what the median, and then the label, summarizes.

assumptions.summary: The words are English and share the probabilities of dictionary words.
Words that look like English are tried first.
Players tweet every day or never, and nobody returns.
Only some non-players can become players.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Rows with a word length other than 5, and rows with very few reports, are removed rather than corrected.
Features used in the neighbor models are standardized to mean 0 and variance 1.
A zero frequency is set to 1 before the weighted regularity is logged.

results_trace.summary: Word attributes do not determine the hard-mode share.
EERIE is ordinary difficulty, at about 75.28 percent accuracy.

verification.summary: The bootstrap mean is 14689.9 and the interval is [11173.04, 17069.15].
The two regularity lines have R-squared 0.02212 and 0.01348.
The chosen neighbor model has MSE 12.35.
The classifier accuracy is 75.28 percent with interval [63.16, 82.76].
